$description: Leadersheet, dark: warm white ink on a night page with lifted cards. Same names as light; every value aliases a primitive.

card.$description: Cards lift off the night page.

muted.$description: Tracks, the picked choice, a feedback banner.

accent.$description: Hover fill on menus and rows (shadcn's name; not the pink).

text.$description: Type. Grey is for labels only: anything a reader has to read or act on is in full ink.

action.$description: The primary button: ink with a pressed edge under it.

primary-edge.$description: The 4 px edge under the ink button, gone when pressed.

border.$description: Lines: hairlines between things, rules around controls, the focus ring.

rule.$description: Control borders and drawn rules: 3:1 on the page and on a card.

accent.$description: The two inks. The pink marks one thing per view and is never an error colour.

signal-text.$description: At night the signal itself is light enough to be text.

data.$description: Drawings: the graph paper behind the home drawing, and the lesson cards' art.

state.$description: Right and wrong. A wrong answer is an X in ink; red is for forms only.

ok.$description: A right answer or a strong call.
